name: GoodWe Battery
tagline: Modular high-voltage LFP battery, from 6.4 kWh to 28.8 kWh per tower.
summary: The GoodWe Lynx F G2 Series is a high-voltage battery made of stackable 3.2 kWh modules, for use with GoodWe EH and ET series inverters.
Up to eight towers can be connected in parallel, so it suits homes through to commercial sites. It is rated IP55 for outdoor installation.

highlights.title: Smart monitoring
highlights.text: Remote diagnosis and updates through the inverter, with automatic reboot after undervoltage.

highlights.title: Easy to install
highlights.text: Stackable modules are recognised automatically and use plug-and-play wiring.

highlights.title: Long-lasting LFP
highlights.text: Lithium iron phosphate cells offer reliable performance and high cycle stability.

highlights.title: IP55 protection
highlights.text: Rated IP55 for safe outdoor installation.

highlights.title: Flexible capacity
highlights.text: Connect up to eight towers in parallel for as much as 230 kWh.
